description: scopes-and-collections-config.md's AsciiDoc `{sgw}` attribute reference was never resolved before publication - it appears literally as the four characters '{sgw}' at least eight times in running prose (e.g. '{sgw} uses a reserved system collection...', 'From {sgw} 4.1, you can opt in...', '{sgw} triggers this function...'). Every other page in the round-27 batch spells out 'Sync Gateway' in full; this is the only page with the raw, unrendered attribute leaking through to a reader (or an AI agent quoting the page verbatim).
